selected_by: Walk-forward pick F6 (2026-10 study) with High Tight Flags moved to separate tracking (HTF ~0R/trade 2007-2026, 4 of 16 years positive, -0.23R on 101 trades since 2023). 2026-10-06 (F6c): High Tight Flag definition tightened (pole +100%, flag peak within 5% of the 52-week high, flag measured from the pole's peak); buy rules unchanged.
trackNote: with the tightened definition (2026-10-06) High Tight Flags averaged +0.5R per trade in the 20-year test (166 trades 2007-2026, positive in 6 of 15 years), but -0.35R over 44 trades in 2026 so far; kept out of the buy rules until the yearly re-study.
idleCashNote: 2026-10 study: parking idle cash in SPY while SPY is above its 200-day SMA (3% band) raised the walk-forward record of the selection procedure from 8.6% to 10.8-12.2%/yr (2010-2026; SPY 12.0%; the range depends on when SPY is sold to fund a fill) and F6b 2007-2026 from 11.9% to 14.7-16.0%/yr with about the same max drawdown (22-23%). Bands of 1-5% gave similar results.

context.note: Display only (never changes buy rules). Calibrated 2026-10-06 on SPY and breadth (% of liquid US stocks above their 50-day SMA), Oct 2005 - Oct 2026 (5,273 sessions): SPY's return and worst drawdown over the next 1 and 3 months by state. Odds are rough: overlapping windows, few independent episodes at the extremes.

spy200.label: Downtrend
spy200.meaning: SPY is below its 200-day, a long-term downtrend. Expect wide swings: about 1 in 3 times SPY fell another 10%+ at some point in the next 3 months.

spy200.label: Testing
spy200.meaning: SPY sits just above its 200-day and can flip either way. In the next 3 months it dipped 5%+ about 1 in 3 times and 10%+ about 1 in 5.

spy200.label: Uptrend
spy200.meaning: Healthy trend, historically the best balance of risk and reward: SPY was higher 3 months later about 3 times in 4, and 10% drops were rare (about 1 in 13).

spy200.label: Extended
spy200.meaning: Stretched (only 15% of days are this far above the 200-day): the next month's gains were about half the usual, and a 5% pullback came within 3 months about 1 in 3 times. Don't chase; not a sell signal, the biggest extensions were rebounds that kept going.

breadth.label: Washed out
breadth.meaning: Capitulation: almost everything has been sold. Bottoms form here and the next 3 months were often strong, but about half the time SPY first fell another 5%. Wait for a breadth thrust before trusting a bounce.

breadth.label: Weak
breadth.meaning: Most stocks are in pullbacks. SPY fell 10%+ at some point in the next 3 months about 1 in 4 times.

breadth.label: Mixed
breadth.meaning: No clear direction; money is rotating between sectors.

breadth.label: Healthy
breadth.meaning: Broad participation. 10% drops in the next 3 months were rare (about 1 in 12).

breadth.label: Strong
breadth.meaning: Very broad buying, historically bullish: SPY was higher 3 months later 80% of the time. Not a top signal on its own.

narrow.label: Narrow market
narrow.text: SPY is strong but most stocks are weak: a few large stocks are carrying the index. Historically a modest warning (SPY higher 3 months later 66% of the time vs 72% otherwise, with deeper dips).

thrust.label: Breadth thrust
thrust.text: Breadth went from 20% or less to 60%+ within 10 sessions. This happened 9 times since 2005; SPY was higher 6 months later in 8 of them (median +13%). It has marked the start of new uptrends.
